name: Footwork (Combat)
body:
Your quick, nimble movements make it difficult for your foes to predict where you will be, and thus make it more difficult for them to strike you in combat.

Prerequisite: Dodge, Nimble Moves, 5 ranks Acrobatics.

Benefit: When wearing light armor or no armor, carrying no more than light encumbrance, and not suffering any effect which reduces your movement, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC. (As with all dodge bonuses, this stacks with the dodge bonus gained from the Dodge feat.)
